scope: function-field d=1, current sector p congruent 5 mod 6
priority_rule: The raw application transport lane has been audited first and formally obstructed; activate the integral Tate-diagonal lane while preserving the Tate-normalized divided-power Rees comparison as a secondary open theorem.

gates.title: Literal object dictionary
gates.result: Every source summand, projector, degree, shift, twist, Frobenius convention and boundary term has a literal carrier. The only possible Airy carrier is the nonzero-frequency Fourier-Cayley sector.

gates.title: Invariant compatibility
gates.result: Zero frequency is excluded by weights. A uniform unit-coefficient Airy term inside an honest untwisted integral q-line projector plus integral residual is excluded by the exact negative p-adic valuation at p=23 and the recorded uniform valuation theorem.
gates.secondary_open_target: Tate-normalized virtual divided-power Rees comparison with explicit compensating valuation and boundary ledger.
gates.pivot_certificate: Proved weight and p-adic integrality mismatch.

gates.title: All-Frobenius trace identity
gates.pass: An exact identity for every Frobenius power in a constructed Tate-normalized virtual category, with literal Tate, Artin-Schreier and punctual corrections.

gates.title: Derived/application transport
gates.target: Divided-power Rees invariance of the wild nonzero-frequency phase, preserving Frobenius and every correction cone.

gates.title: Half-sector crown assembly
gates.result: Even a successful virtual transport leaves the original q-line error-versus-main-term theorem or a weaker one-sided nonfailure certificate.
gates.claim_boundary: No full d=1 or integer Fortune claim.

gates.title: Integral model and comparison
gates.pass: A perfect C_p-equivariant integral Airy complex and Weil-compatible comparison realizing both the generic Adams trace and modular Smith/Tate contraction.
gates.current_object: M_p = RGamma_c(A1, A_O tensor^p)^{mu_3} with cyclic action and Frobenius.

gates.title: Bounded-cone attempt
gates.pass: Uniformly bounded generic comparison cone after the explicit Tate correction.
gates.known_obstruction: The natural Dwork lift has linearly growing surviving defect.

gates.title: Linear-cone cancellation
gates.pass: Absolute Frobenius trace O(p^((p+1)/2)) after exact trivial and Artin-Schreier subtraction.

gates.title: Analytic propagation
gates.pass: Absolute Airy estimate and insertion into the exact application ledger.

gates.title: Full d=1 sector ledger
gates.pass: All other prime sectors and small primes are separately certified before any full d=1 claim.
